annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Reliability Society Standards Committee (IEEE SA)
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines capabilities for interventions when autonomous or semi-autonomous systems exhibit anomalous behavior.
Capabilities are meant to be integrated into an operational Safety Management System.
Aims to preserve freedom from unacceptable risk of harm.
Companion IEEE 7009-2024 sets fail-safe design methods for autonomous systems, serving developers, users and regulators.
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA project page for draft standard P7009.1 on safety management of autonomous and semi-autonomous systems, covering interventions during anomalous behavior. It also lists the companion IEEE 7009-2024 fail-safe design standard, which gives methods for robust, transparent, accountable fail-safe mechanisms.
